title: Census: hybrid estimator approved, then held — fix inputs first (door ledger), measured not assumed
summary: Operator approved a simpler camera-floor census, footage ground truth (Frigate 2 recordings, 10-03) showed it only 20% within ±2 — door flow is needed to hold a party. Hybrid (residents + max of camera surplus / guest room / door tally; AWAY-independent empty anchor; graceful degradation, no new switches; main-entry-door question) passed 3 plan-review rounds but its D0-REPLAY was NO-GO: the door ledger is the bottleneck. Probes found: door handler fires once per 0->N edge and discards headcount (8-person arrival = 4 rows), _extract_camera_stem misses _person_occupancy_2 so Frigate-2 sensors bypass dedup (garage_a 119->61 crossings when fixed), exit bias from family_room firing 811x/day, BLE departures lag 4-8 min, arrivals never BLE-attributed. Plan PLANNING_census_inputs_first.md rev2 committed; needs plan re-review then Tier 2-DB build (stem fix, per-door dedup/neighbours, peak_person_count column, asymmetric BLE window). Face lookup fix (nonexistent er.async_entries_for_platform) merged to develop.
why: Operator: cameras count people better than names; most households are 1-2 people; many houses have no interior cams so degrade by what's configured. Measuring before building twice reversed my recommendation (simple->hybrid->inputs-first); building the estimator on a ledger that logs a group of 8 as one cancelled round-trip would ship noise.
alternatives_considered: runtime vision counting (same blind spots as cams; kept as parked D7 for door group count)
implications: Truth for 10-03 now operator-confirmed: Ezinne out 12:13-12:57; operator+Jaya left ~13:55 (operator back 15:42, Jaya back with operator 23:24 via garage_a); 8 guests front door ~14:22; long-stay guest out AM back evening; visitor left 23:00; guest left 23:55; no pets; doorbell_lite=garage_a; no 'drop-off guy' (dictation error). Fixture quality/tests/fixtures/census_ground_truth_2026_10_03.csv needs correction card. person.oji_udezue trackers pruned to phone-only (cflare app GPS + 2 BLE).
revisit_trigger: Re-run D0-REPLAY after input fixes; build hybrid only if gates 2/3/5 pass; if door group counts still fail, unpark D7 vision.
